marking_points.criterion: Obtains grid size and traverses valid row indices.
Traverses valid column indices for each row.
Distinguish es band cells with abs(r-c)<=1.
Rejects non zero outside the band.
Returns False immediately on either violation.
Returns True only after all cells have been checked.
Uses correct 2 D indexing and handles 1×1 input.

acceptable_alternatives: Equivalent technically correct wording or valid implementation earning the specified independent points.
partial_credit_notes: Award each stated point independently up to the total; do not double-credit the same idea.

verification.technical: Concrete marking points independently reasoned from the defined context and exact 2027 scope.
verification.code_check: Executable checks saved under checks/ where applicable.

test_code:
assert is_band_matrix([[8,2,0],[4,7,3],[0,5,9]])
assert not is_band_matrix([[8,2,1],[4,7,3],[0,5,9]])
assert not is_band_matrix([[8,0],[2,7]])
assert is_band_matrix([[1]])
assert not is_band_matrix([[0]])
